caption: The drawing depicts a wooden yoke, composed primarily of a long, slightly curved horizontal wooden beam with an overall brown, weathered appearance. On each end of the beam, there is a looped wooden piece, forming a roughly oval shape attached to the underside of the beam, likely intended for fitting around the necks of animals. Two vertical wooden pegs, one positioned above each loop, are placed near either end of the yoke, angling slightly outward. In the center, attached to the underside of the main beam, is a large circular iron ring. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there are no other objects present in the drawing.
title: Oxen Yoke
